name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (Government of India)
des: The Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (GOI) is a Centrally Sponsored Scholarship Scheme funded by the Government of India and implemented in Maharashtra by two separate departments — the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance (SJSA) for SC and Neo-Buddhist students, and the Tribal Development Department for ST students — through the MahaDBT portal. Launched under the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (for SC) and Ministry of Tribal Affairs (for ST), it provides comprehensive financial assistance including 100% tuition fee reimbursement, examination fee reimbursement, and monthly maintenance allowance to eligible students pursuing post-matric education from Class 11 up to PhD level. For MBA students, the scheme falls under Group I (professional courses) which carries the highest maintenance allowance rate. Family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum. Benefits are disbursed in 2 installments via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account. A student can avail benefits for a maximum of 2 professional courses in a lifetime under this scheme. Applications for A.Y. 2025–26 are open until 30 June 2026.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of Tuition Fees and all compulsory non-refundable fees charged by the institution
MBA falls under Group I (professional courses) — highest maintenance allowance slab
SC/Neo-Buddhist students — Group I Maintenance Allowance: Hostellers ₹1,200/month, Day Scholars ₹550/month (for 10 months)
ST students — Group I Maintenance Allowance: Hostellers ₹1,200/month, Day Scholars ₹550/month (same as SC)
Government hostellers not receiving books/stationery from hostel get additional 1/3rd of hosteller maintenance allowance
ST students — Additional Reader Allowance: Group I & II ₹240/month, Group III ₹200/month, Group IV ₹160/month
ST students — Escort Allowance: ₹160/month | Special Pay: ₹160/month
ST students — Study Tour: ₹1,600/annum | Thesis Typing/Printing: ₹1,600/annum | Book Grant: ₹1,200/annum
SC students — Additional Disability Allowance: Hostellers ₹800/month (₹9,600/year), Day Scholars ₹600/month (₹7,200/year) for Divyangjan students with certified disability
Maintenance allowance paid from date of admission to date of final examination — maximum 10 months per year
Benefits available for maximum 2 professional courses in a lifetime
Amount disbursed in 2 installments via DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank account
criteria: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Neo-Buddhist, or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category as per government records
Applicant must be a permanent resident/domicile of Maharashtra
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 — this is a strict GOI limit for full scholarship
Must have passed SSC (Class 10) or equivalent — post-matric level courses (Class 11 and above) only
For MBA: admission must be through MAH-MBA CET CAP round — management quota and institute-level admissions are NOT eligible
Institution must be a government-recognized college in Maharashtra (Private Deemed Universities are NOT eligible)
If student fails for the first time, only Exam Fee + Maintenance Allowance is provided for that year; tuition fee is not reimbursed
If student fails consecutively for 2 years in the same class, all benefits are suspended until the student passes and moves to the next year
Two consecutive back-to-back education gaps of 2 years make ST students ineligible to apply
Student must not be receiving any other major government scholarship simultaneously
Maximum 2 professional courses allowed in a lifetime under this scheme
For married girl students: husband's income certificate is also required in addition to parents' income
required_documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (family income ≤ ₹2.5 lakh)
CAP Allotment Letter (mandatory for MBA — proof of MAH-MBA CET CAP round admission)
Admission Receipt / Tuition Fee Receipt for current academic year
Bonafide Certificate from the MBA institute
Previous Year Marksheet (SSC, HSC, or last qualifying examination)
Hostel Certificate (if staying in hostel — for higher hosteller allowance)
Husband Income Certificate (if married girl student)
Disability Certificate issued by competent medical authority (if applicable — for additional disability allowance)
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal, academic, and bank details
For SC/Neo-Buddhist students: navigate to 'Social Justice & Special Assistance Department' → select 'Post Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India) for SC Students'
For ST students: navigate to 'Tribal Development Department' → select 'Post Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India) for ST Students'
Select MBA course under Group I — verify your institute is listed and eligible on MahaDBT
Fill in academic details, CAP allotment details, hostel/day scholar status, and bank account details accurately
Upload all required documents in JPG/PDF format as specified
Review all details carefully and submit before deadline
Note Application ID and track real-time status via Granular Application Tracking on MahaDBT portal
Ensure institute principal verifies your application on MahaDBT — unverified applications are rejected
Applications for A.Y. 2025–26 are open until 30 June 2026; re-apply for A.Y. 2023–24 and 2024–25 also valid until 30 June 2026
